reviews.comment: Nice guy, but very little grades in the entire class and nothing is on canvas. Very old school classroom set up. Two exams, a paper, and quizzes. All in person on paper nothing on canvas other than a syllabus and schedule. Must read and must study, no way around it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr. Mize!  He makes medieval lit fascinating and fun.  You should take at least one class with him during your time at A&M.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Took his Beowulf's Afterlives class. He gave great lectures & I came out with a genuine appreciation for Beowulf. Insane amount of reading & only 4 grades throughout the whole course, so that's rough, but everyone in the class managed it. Don't recommend taking it if you have lots of other English classes. Definitely one of my favorite profs!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mize was the best English professor I had while at Texas A&M. His lectures were engaging and interesting; he made me excited to learn in a way that I hadn't been while in undergraduate. He always walked into class with a smile on his face no matter what and treated us with respect and kindness. I would highly recommend him to anyone.
He is the BEST professor I ever had. He has a true passion for the class he teaches. He deserved the best from this university. He makes me so happy to learn. 10/10

Professor Mize may be one of the most brilliant professors I have taken. He is kind, extremely knowledgable, approachable, and always walks in to class with a smile on his face. I took 330 which just wasn't an option on here, but it went great. Readings, lectures, and 3 tests. You need to pay attention, but he equips you well!

Dr. Mize is AMAZING! Take at least one of his classes if you get the chance, he's absolutely brilliant and won't hesitate to share all of his incredible knowledge with you. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but the tests are based on what we discuss in class so it's in your best interest to go. Tests are hard but not if you pay attention.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you're literate and can breathe you can get a B in Dr. Mize's 313. An A requires more work (including... actually doing the readings, surprise surprise) but there were really never any surprises on the exams. Overall recommended, he chooses interesting readings and makes lectures fun with relevant stories.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Mize is a very nice professor. Not an easy A however, if you work hard, you will receive the grade you deserve. Doesnt make you pay for tons of books. His instructions are clear and gives feedback if you ask for it. Friendly approach. Highly recommended!

I love Dr. Mize and his lectures were pretty enjoyable. He's not a tough grader, but you definitely can't put no effort in and expect a good grade. If you keep up with the reading and take notes in class, you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mize is honestly one of the best professors I have ever had for any English course. Not only is he knowledgeable in his subject matters, but he is also passionate about them. Three short assignments and a test is all you will do for his class as well as pop quizzes every now and then, so come to class. He will give great feedback if you ask!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Mize is awesome! He's passionate about the subject he teaches and is incredibly knowledgeable. Each class has assigned readings so you do need the book,  but some pieces can be found online. There are only 2 essays based on readings in class, and Dr. Mize does a great job of going over the readings and helping you understand them.
